mentions.name: Joyus
mentions.description: A social media posting app built as a proof of concept of a friction intervention. Users must answer three questions before posting; each answer auto-submits once it exceeds 100 characters, and the third answer becomes the post. The goal is to encourage slow thinking before posting and, secondarily, to help reframe negative experiences.
mentions.problem: Impulsive, reactive posting on social media; the app adds deliberate friction before publishing.
mentions.source_excerpt: Instructions: you have to answer three questions; each one will auto-submit once your response goes over 100 characters; the answer to the third question is your "post". It's a proof of concept of a friction intervention for social media to encourage slow thinking before posting (and hopefully reframing negative experiences in the mind, it's kind of dual purpose).
